spots.name: Reveille Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,640 m (8,662 ft).

spots.name: Torrance Ranch
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 202 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L456897.

spots.name: 7J Ranch:  North Pond
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 154 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L50898687.

spots.name: Balloon Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,476 m (4,843 ft).

spots.name: Pioneer Mine
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Brainwash Bluff panorama
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing 0-360. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Control Tower
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Cedar Gate panorama
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.
